answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 12 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 780 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the gale here is verification, the pearl of cost is what stops the farm, and the comet of the record keeps every claim checkable.
